title: School Software — Unified Typed Import Envelope v1 (DRAFT)
description: The single ingestion contract for the school software (REQ §4, R-IMP1). A minimal, stable OUTER contract plus a free-form PAYLOAD selected by doc_type. STATUS: DRAFT v0.1 — the plan doc-types (chapter_plan/session_plan) are stable because they wrap the locked Project-03 artifact; the question/question_set payloads are PROVISIONAL pending Project 04/05 alignment (R-IMP5). DESIGN NOTES: (1) Two-layer validation, mirroring Project 03's own Layer-1/Layer-2 split: THIS schema validates the outer contract + a light payload marker-gate; the import harness then runs a SECOND validator pass dispatching payload to its full schema by doc_type (plan types -> the locked Project-03 plan schema C5_PlanSchema_v1.json; question -> the Project-04 question schema once ratified). (2) ASYMMETRY by design: for plan doc-types, payload is the ENTIRE Project-03 plan artifact UNCHANGED (so Project 03 emits as-is, the app never re-renders, and the existing locked plan schema validates payload verbatim). For question doc-types, payload is envelope-native (greenfield, authored directly in this shape). (3) The outer subject/class_level/curation_tag are the app's authoritative INDEXED copies; a harness consistency-check (not expressible cleanly in JSON Schema across nesting) asserts they equal the payload's. (4) import_batch_id, imported_at, and importer_user are STAMPED BY THE APP after validation and are NOT part of the incoming contract. (5) review_status defaults to 'draft' on import; 'reviewed'/'gold' are set later via the Project-03 REVIEW workflow (D-#3). (6) To EXTEND: add a value to doc_type's enum and a matching branch in allOf + a $defs payload schema; the outer contract never changes (envelope_version stays 1.x for additive changes).
$comment: Draft 2020-12 to match Project 03's validate_plan.py (jsonschema Draft202012Validator). Envelope_version is intentionally named distinctly from the payload's own schema_version to avoid collision when a plan artifact is nested under payload.

envelope_version.description: Version of THIS outer contract, independent of any payload schema_version.

doc_type.description: Selects the payload sub-schema. 'question_set' is app-generated (REQ-ASSEMBLE) and reserved here only for possible future bulk import.

subject.description: Authoritative indexed copy. Harness asserts equality with payload.subject for plan types.

class_level.description: Authoritative indexed copy (C1–C5). One evolving plan schema spans all classes (R-IMP2).

address.description: The book-hierarchy address (division). Required for plan doc-types; optional for question doc-types.

curation_tag.description: Mirrors the Project-03 curation tag. Required for plan doc-types.

pinned_to.description: Layout/core versions the artifact was built against (carried through from Project 03).

provenance.description: Author-supplied lineage (R-X2). App stamps import_batch_id/imported_at/importer_user separately after validation.

tags.description: Cross-cutting, app-indexed filter tags (controlled vocabulary, R-X6). Lifted from payload for questions or set directly.

review_status.description: Quality gate (D-#3). 'draft' = authored, not yet REVIEW-passed; 'reviewed' = passed the Project-03 substance REVIEW; 'gold' = Principal-locked. Export/analytics filter on this.

rendered_markdown.description: Co-generated teacher-facing Markdown (Option B). Required for plan doc-types; the app displays/PDFs this and NEVER re-renders from payload.

payload.description: Doc-type-specific body. For plan types this is the ENTIRE Project-03 plan artifact (validated in full by the plan schema in the harness's second pass); for question types it is envelope-native (see $defs.questionPayload).

allOf.$comment: Chapter Plan: wrap the whole Project-03 chapter artifact; require display Markdown + address + curation tag.
Question: PROVISIONAL envelope-native payload, pending Project-04 ratification.

anchor_word.description: Must match the subject's book hierarchy (BAN→পাঠ, MATH/SCI→অধ্যায়, ENG→Unit/Lesson) — full subject↔anchor check lives in the harness, as in the plan schema.

bloomLevelEN.description: Canonical English Bloom levels for app indexing (the plan schema accepts both Bangla and English on the rendered surface; the app index uses English).

questionPayload.$comment: DRAFT / PROVISIONAL — illustrative shape to anchor Project-04 alignment (R-IMP5). additionalProperties kept TRUE during alignment; tighten to false on ratification.

answer.description: Free type during alignment (string, array, or object). Tighten with Project 04.
